select count(0) from ess_apply_deduct_time t where T.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# AND TO_DATE(#TO_DATE:VARCHAR#, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') > TO_DATE(#APPLY_TO_DATE_STR:VARCHAR# || T.TO_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(#FROM_DATE:VARCHAR#, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') < TO_DATE(#APPLY_TO_DATE_STR:VARCHAR# || T.FROM_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND T.OT_APPLY_CODE = #OT_APPLY_TYPE_CODE:VARCHAR#
